title: Connect to your server
subtitle: OpenFamily is self-hosted — point the app at your own server.
hint: Use the same address you open in your browser (e.g. http://192.168.1.10:3001), or your HTTPS / Tailscale address.

errors.invalid: Enter a valid URL starting with http:// or https://
errors.unreachable: Couldn't reach this server. Check the address and that the server is running.
